name: Check that read-only agent file system tools cannot write
description: An AI agent gets File System Tools with the Read Only option and a List Directory tool. It lists its tools, tries to create a file, and confirms the file does not exist. Use it to check that Read Only exposes only the Read tool.
shortDescription: Confirms that File System Tools in Read Only mode offer no Write or Edit tool.
keyFeatures: File System Tools with the Read Only option
A write attempt that must fail
PASS/FAIL report in the execution log
prerequisites: Server setting bytechef.ai.agent-utils.file-system.enabled=true (BYTECHEF_AI_AGENT_UTILS_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED), which turns on the File System, Glob, Grep and List Directory tools
idealFor: Administrators of self-hosted ByteChef who want to check how the Agent Utils file and shell tools behave before they let agent builders use them.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Run in the workflow editor.
Run the checks: the AI Agent lists its tools, tries to write a file and lists the workspace.
Log the report: the Logger step prints the agent's PASS/FAIL table to the execution log.
